results.name: Adult Craft Night with Light + Love Arts
results.description: Ticketed guided craft evenings for adults run by Light + Love Arts, with a main project, side activities and drinks.
results.notes: Tickets sold via hisawyer booking page; a studio's paid workshops, not a member community. Only 2 events.

results.name: Art Folk
results.description: A casual craft club for adults at the Weaverville Community Center. Bring your own project or use the shared supplies, with beginner help available. Suggested donations fund supplies.
results.notes: Run by Town of Weaverville; recurring monthly since May with upcoming dates. No separate website found.

results.name: Asheville Area Job Hunters
results.description: A peer meetup for job seekers to swap leads, share resumes and support one another over drinks in a hotel bar. Open to anyone looking for work in the Asheville area.
results.notes: Peer support for job seekers, not lead generation; 11 events Jun-Aug 2026. Meetup page only.

results.name: Asheville Business Referral Networking
results.description: A weekly virtual and monthly in-person business referral networking group.
results.notes: Referral and lead-generation chapter; business-development programming.

results.name: Asheville Deaf Community Meetup
results.description: A relaxed social for Deaf and Hard of Hearing people, families and allies, open to fluent ASL users and learners alike. Held at The Hop Ice Cream and Pop Bubble Tea.
results.notes: Explore Asheville listings confirm recurring meetups; no group site or Facebook page found in search.

results.name: Asheville Hash House Harriers (AVLH3)
results.description: A hash running and walking club that follows a hare-laid trail through town and trails, followed by songs and drinks. Open to adults of any pace.
results.notes: Run #871 and upcoming events; Meetup lists thousands of members. No separate website found.

results.name: Asheville Moms Network
results.description: A social group for local moms and their kids to meet and make friends through outings like farmers market walks.
results.notes: Only one Meetup event (Dec 2025); grey, kept. Distinct from m:asheville-community-moms-group as far as can be told.

results.name: Asheville Reiki Healing Connection
results.description: Reiki certification classes taught by a Reiki Master.
results.notes: Single paid certification class by one practitioner; no member community.

results.name: Asheville Stepmom Collective
results.description: A monthly social meetup for stepmoms in the Asheville area to connect over drinks and conversation at local breweries, with no agenda.
results.notes: New group (first meetup Jul 2026, second Aug 2026); Meetup page only.

results.name: Asheville Yoga for Men
results.description: A men-only, all-levels yoga practice that meets regularly in a relaxed setting. Casual attire is encouraged.
results.notes: 23 events Dec 2025 onward with one upcoming; organizer-led but a standing men's community. Venue changes.

results.name: AVL Mens Meetup
results.description: A community-building evening for Asheville-area men to meet each other and learn about local men's groups. Gathers at a brewery space.
results.home_base: The Mule, Sweeten Creek Road, Asheville
results.notes: Two Eventbrite events with one upcoming; grey, kept.

results.name: Black Mountain Bluegrass Jam
results.description: A weekly unplugged bluegrass jam where players bring instruments and join in, with listeners welcome. Moves to the patio in nice weather.
results.notes: 38 events, 8 upcoming; brewery-hosted open jam circle. known_website is an aggregator so omitted.

results.name: Carolina Real Estate Investors Association
results.description: A local real estate investors club with monthly main meetings featuring speakers, panels and peer networking.
results.notes: Grey: investor association with regular members, not a lead-gen chapter, though business oriented. Meetup page only.

results.name: Community Ceramics
results.description: Paid paint-your-own-pottery sip and paint sessions.
results.notes: One ticketed $45 paint-and-sip event.

results.name: Dark City Poets Society
results.description: A Black Mountain poetry group founded in 2020 that holds a monthly critique meeting at the library and a monthly public reading. Regular poets read alongside open participants.
results.home_base: Oak and Grist Distilling, Black Mountain
results.notes: Earlier research found founders and library ties; events upcoming through Dec 2026.

results.name: East Asheville Library Evening Book Club
results.description: A monthly evening book club where readers discuss the month's pick at East Asheville Public Library.
results.notes: Library-run club; listings only Dec 2025 and Jan 2026 in our data.

results.name: Ferguson Family YMCA Bridge Club
results.description: A free, friendly contract bridge club open to all, newcomers included. Meets in the multi-purpose room at the Ferguson Family YMCA.
results.notes: YMCA schedule page describes standing bridge club; upcoming date Oct 2026.

results.name: Games, Tunes and Brews
results.description: A casual board and tabletop game meetup at breweries. Members bring a favorite game and a friend.
results.notes: Two Meetup events Jan-Feb 2026; grey, kept as dormant.

results.name: Highland Brewing Volleyball League
results.description: Weeknight recreational volleyball leagues on the outdoor courts at Highland Brewing, with women's, men's and co-ed divisions.
results.notes: Distinct from c:highland-brewing-pick-up-volleyball. Venue-run league with returning teams; grey, kept.

results.name: Inquiry Circle for The Work of Byron Katie
results.description: A small monthly circle that uses Byron Katie's four questions to examine stressful thoughts. Free, hosted by a licensed clinical mental health counselor in Biltmore Village.
results.notes: Free, donation-based recurring circle; Meetup page only.

results.name: Kalyana-Mitta Meditation Center
results.description: A small meditation sangha offering frequent group sittings with guided mindfulness practice. Attendees email ahead to say when they plan to come.
results.notes: 157 Meetup sittings through Mar 2026, then none; may have moved off Meetup.

results.name: Liberty Bicycles Slow-cial Gravel Ride
results.description: A social-paced monthly gravel ride starting at Rice Pinnacle in Bent Creek. Hosted by Liberty Bicycles and open to all.
results.notes: Standing monthly ride with 10 events and one upcoming; shop-hosted but with regulars, so kept.

results.name: Medicine Wheel Connection Circle
results.description: A nature-based connection circle in local parks, guided by a ceremonial practitioner, built around medicine wheel teachings and reflection.
results.notes: Grey: practitioner-led, 2 events May 2026, pricing unknown. Kept given leniency.

results.name: Mills River Bluegrass Jam
results.description: A monthly open bluegrass jam in the Mills River Brewing taproom. Players of all skill levels and listeners are welcome.
results.notes: 11 events with two upcoming; brewery-hosted participatory jam.

results.name: Nature's Comfort Healing Grief Group
results.description: A peer-led grief support group for widows, widowers and people who have lost a partner, meeting for gentle healing walks and support sessions outdoors.
results.home_base: Carrier Park and Botanical Garden, Asheville
results.notes: Two upcoming Oct 2026 events; Meetup URL slug is from an earlier group name.

results.name: Old Time Moderate Jam
results.description: A moderate-paced old-time music jam where rotating leaders present tunes for everyone to learn and play along. Continues the former jam at Laurey's Catering.
results.notes: 10 events, 3 upcoming. Separate from other old-time jams in the index.

results.name: Patton Ave Cruise-In Asheville
results.description: A casual Saturday-evening car cruise-in on Patton Avenue where car enthusiasts show off their rides and talk builds.
results.notes: Facebook-only listings, 3 events Jun-Aug 2026; no page found in search. Grey, kept.

results.name: Read 2 Succeed Volunteer Tutors
results.description: A volunteer community of reading tutors who each support a K-5 student across a school year in Asheville and Buncombe County. Includes monthly tutor huddles.
results.notes: Listed events were onboarding trainings; the nonprofit has a recurring tutor community per its site. Grey, kept.

results.name: SeekHealing
results.description: A free social-health nonprofit community in Asheville offering weekly connection practice meetings, listening training and peer-driven support groups.
results.notes: Idealist and seekhealing.org confirm a nonprofit with peer meetings at no cost; c:seekhealing-blipoc-support-group is a sub-series.

results.name: Skeletons in the Closet: Queer Horror Book Club
results.description: A monthly book club reading queer horror, held at Firestorm Books and Coffee. Each meeting discusses a chosen title.
results.notes: 3 events Jul-Sep 2026 on Firestorm's own event pages; no standalone site.

results.name: Star Sounds Asheville
results.description: Ticketed sound bath and gong meditation sessions led by one practitioner.
results.notes: Practitioner-led paid sound healing sessions, no member community.

results.name: Swannanoa Public Library Star Trek Fan Club
results.description: A monthly fan club for adults who love Star Trek, with episode watch-alongs, trivia, discussion and themed crafts at the Swannanoa library.
results.notes: Library-run named fan club; listings Jul and Aug 2026.

results.name: The Moon and Laurel Events
results.description: Paid retreats and workshops combining yoga, forest bathing and sound healing.
results.notes: Event-promoter style retreats and workshops, no standing group.

results.name: Tulle Talk
results.description: A free monthly meetup for drag, fire and burlesque performers to share stories and skills and build a supportive local scene.
results.notes: 6 events since May 2026, one upcoming; no fee to join.

results.name: Weaverville Expectant and New Parents Group
results.description: A casual weekly gathering for expectant parents and caregivers of babies up to 18 months, with play mats and toys for the little ones.
results.notes: Four July 2026 listings, none after; may be a seasonal series.

results.name: Whole Creative Living Collective
results.description: A creative community offering a monthly reset circle, coworking sessions and workshops for creatives at Story Parlor in West Asheville.
results.notes: Grey: some paid workshops but drop-in circles. Overlaps c:creatives-over-easy (its monthly series); left for reconciliation.

results.name: WNC Small Business Networking and Strategy
results.description: Small business networking meetups with cigars and referrals.
results.notes: Business networking and referral exchange; 2 events Dec 2025.

results.name: Youth Advocacy Collective
results.description: A monthly meeting of service providers who work with young adults aged 13 to 24, for networking, resource sharing and collaboration.
results.notes: Goodwill-hosted interagency collective; grey since it is professional peers, not business development. Kept.
